headline_marked: 18-year-old [[beaten to death by neighbor]] in Dhaka's Rayerbag
headline: 18-year-old beaten to death by neighbor in Dhaka's Rayerbag
summary: The youth, who worked at a carton factory, was allegedly killed over a trivial dispute involving a comment about marijuana use.
details: An 18-year-old youth named Rifat Mridha was killed on Monday evening after being beaten by a neighbor in the Khanbari area of Rayerbag, Jatrabari, Dhaka.
Rifat worked at a local carton factory and lived in a rented house with his parents. He was the fifth of six siblings, originally from Patuakhali.
According to Rifat's father, Hashem Mridha, the conflict began when a neighbor named Shakil asked Rifat why he was sitting on the road and suggested he smoke marijuana.

When Rifat replied that he did not smoke marijuana, Shakil allegedly began insulting and beating him. Although the dispute initially seemed to resolve, Shakil returned shortly after to attack him again.
The second attack involved punches and kicks that left Rifat unconscious. The attacker then fled the scene.
Rifat was rushed to a local hospital and later transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) as his condition worsened.
Doctors at DMCH declared him dead upon arrival. The body is currently kept in the morgue.
Family members reported that the accused, Shakil and his family, have locked their house and fled the area. Police have been informed of the death.

headline_marked: 3 [[Myanmar security forces members detained]] after crossing Naf River
headline: 3 Myanmar security forces members detained after crossing Naf River
summary: The individuals, including a Border Guard Police member, swam across the river from Rakhine State to enter Bangladesh illegally.
details: Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) detained three members of the Myanmar security forces who swam across the Naf River from Rakhine State to enter Bangladesh.
The detainees include one member of the Border Guard Police (BGP) and two members of the junta's security forces. They were caught near the Borofkol area of Teknaf municipality.

The individuals were identified as Second Lieutenant Hein De Het, police officer Hein Zaw, and BGP member Kyaw Naing. They had been held captive by the Arakan Army (AA) in Rakhine State for some time.
According to the BGB, the three men escaped from an AA-controlled residential building near the BGP 1st Battalion headquarters in Maungdaw Township on July 19.
After escaping, they walked six kilometers to the Naf River bank and used jerrycans to swim across the river for approximately two hours on Monday morning.
The three men were handed over to the Teknaf Model Police Station on Monday night. They are facing charges of illegal entry into Bangladesh and will be be sent to Cox's Bazar court on Tuesday.
